data.name: Einas
data.gender_notes: Einas is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ain', meaning 'one'. This name signifies a woman who is graceful, delicate and unique, just like a single drop of water. In Islamic history, Einas is mentioned as the name of one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for her beautiful character and elegant manners. The name Einas carries the meaning “Graceful, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Einas usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: إيناس

in_urdu.name: ایناس
in_urdu.meaning: مذکر نام، اسمی، ماء کے لیے مخصوص، ایک خاص نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایناس نام کی اصل یونانی زبان سے ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے ماء، اسلامی روایات میں ایک خاص نام ہے جو خیر اور برکت کا اشارہ ہے، اس نام کی وجہ سے والدین اپنے بچوں کو ایک نیک اور برکت والا انسان بناتے ہیں
